## Project overview

The Streamlit Budget Dashboard is my second attempt at a bank statement
processor, turning the original data-cleaning pipeline into an interactive
application. It accepts CSV exports from most banks, lets users map each
bank's columns, and brings transactions into a consistent format for review,
categorization, analysis, and budgeting.

## Key features

- Imports one or more bank CSVs and supports per-file column mapping.
- Lets users review and edit transaction details and resolve uncategorized
  merchants and categories; saved mappings can be reused for future imports.
- Provides transaction overview, date-range spending and savings analytics,
  and session-based monthly budgets.
- Exports categorized transactions as a consistent CSV.

## Privacy and limitations

The app is designed for personal bank statements. When run locally, processing
stays on the user's machine. The hosted app processes uploads on Streamlit
Community Cloud during the active session; sessions are temporary, so users
should download their categorized CSV to keep a copy.
